contexts.text: The reward of those who undergo temptations, oppressions, etc. Treated of.
To deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor () = to do the good of charity.
(The oppressed, a class of the good.)
Some of those who (are being instructed by the Lord in truths, and are being led to good) are called the oppressed ().
These are the things which are described by the sons of Israel being oppressed by the Egyptians... AC 6657:end.
I have seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them () = on account of the endeavour to subjugate...

A sojourner thou shalt not afflict, and shalt not oppress () = that those who want to be instructed... are not to be infested... To afflict = to be infested with falsities; to oppress = to be infested with evils... AC 9268.
To redeem from the oppression of man () = to deliver from the falsities of evil... The oppression of man = the destruction of truth through falsities.
To oppress for nought () = falsification; for falsities are nought.
By oppression upon the loins () is signified that there is no perception of the good of love.
Who doeth judgment for the oppressed (). By the oppressed are here meant those who are in falsities from ignorance. Their oppression is by Spirits who are in falsities.
By the waters of oppression () are signified temptations as to the truths of faith... Straitness, and oppression, = states of temptations.
They shall cry unto Jehovah because of the oppressions () = their grief because of the defect of truth and thence of spiritual good...
They who are called the oppressed () are the nations who are in truths and goods from the Lord, who... are detained by those who seduce them and exclude truths from them.
